title: Ruleset
description: A user's rule set: the document that is imported, exported, synced and enforced. `timeZone` pins the zone every schedule, bedtime and budget day is evaluated in (the device zone is never an input). `pendingTimeZone` is set only while a time-zone change waits (both zones apply, the stricter wins). `workHours` is the user's working hours, which rules opt into with `{ "ref": "workHours" }`. `relaxedWeekends` (optional, off when absent) softens bedtime on Friday and Saturday nights and short-video surfaces on Saturdays and Sundays. Strict: unknown fields are rejected, keys are unique (`x-uniqueBy`) and the serialised document must not exceed 256 KB.

revision.description: Monotonic, assigned by whoever edits the set.

relaxedWeekends.title: RelaxedWeekends
relaxedWeekends.description: Softer limits on weekends, chosen by the user (SEMANTICS.md §6.4). Absent means off. When enabled, a bedtime window that starts on a Friday or Saturday asks for an intention instead of blocking, and on Saturdays and Sundays (local dates) a `block` or `hide-feed` rule on a short-video surface asks for an intention instead. Turning it on is loosening (waits, §8); turning it off is tightening.
